title: #05 TRIALS FOR NAVIGATOR OPEN
lines: DETAILS: Trials for Navigator will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing Trial Tasks for Trial EXP, and increasing the level of Path of Trials.
REWARDS: EPOQUE Collection - Behind the Words for Morgan, Headhunting Permit, Module Materials, Elite Materials, Battle Records, LMD, Furniture Parts, etc.
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available at the Store for a limited time.
Advanced Special Training Bundle CONTENTS: Top Operator Training Apparatus * 1, Senior Operator Training Apparatus * 1, Professional Operator Training Apparatus * 2
Top Operator Training Apparatus: Use to level up a 6-star Operator who has been promoted to Elite 2 directly to Elite 2, Level 90. Resources already invested will not be returned after usage.
CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 12, Top Operator Skill Training Pack * 1, Senior Operator Skill Training Pack * 1, Professional Operator Skill Training Pack * 1
Top Operator Skill Training Pack: You can select a 6-star Operator that meets the requirements and level a skill to Specialization Level 3.
